visual_review.identity: Warm charcoal-gray rounded-polygon paving with prominent muted brown earth joints and medium infill stones. No orange glow, emissive specks, fire or metal symbols.
visual_review.detail_density: Approximately 5-7 main stones across width instead of requested 8-12. Broad stones have more than 2-3 small tonal face patches in places and substantial medium joint infill; source remains low-contrast.
visual_review.scale_caveat: At a 256-unit full-image period, main stones would often span about 30-65 world units. Scale remains an initial parent preview proposal, not automatic production acceptance.
visual_review.style_caveat: Dark matte rounded paving retained, warmer and somewhat more brown than original. Residual subtle face texture remains and is documented without filtering.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native; material identity retained; original tone 1 is catalog-only. No scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
